object.name: TransactionPartnerUser
object.description: Describes a transaction with a user.
object.rst_description: Describes a transaction with a user.

annotations.name: type
annotations.description: Type of the transaction partner, always 'user'
annotations.rst_description: Type of the transaction partner, always 'user'

annotations.name: transaction_type
annotations.description: Type of the transaction, currently one of 'invoice_payment' for payments via invoices, 'paid_media_payment' for payments for paid media, 'gift_purchase' for gifts sent by the bot, 'premium_purchase' for Telegram Premium subscriptions gifted by the bot, 'business_account_transfer' for direct transfers from managed business accounts
annotations.html_description: Type of the transaction, currently one of “invoice_payment” for payments via invoices, “paid_media_payment” for payments for paid media, “gift_purchase” for gifts sent by the bot, “premium_purchase” for Telegram Premium subscriptions gifted by the bot, “business_account_transfer” for direct transfers from managed business accounts
annotations.rst_description: Type of the transaction, currently one of 'invoice_payment' for payments via invoices, 'paid_media_payment' for payments for paid media, 'gift_purchase' for gifts sent by the bot, 'premium_purchase' for Telegram Premium subscriptions gifted by the bot, 'business_account_transfer' for direct transfers from managed business accounts

annotations.name: affiliate
annotations.description: Optional. Information about the affiliate that received a commission via this transaction. Can be available only for 'invoice_payment' and 'paid_media_payment' transactions.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Information about the affiliate that received a commission via this transaction. Can be available only for “invoice_payment” and “paid_media_payment” transactions.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Information about the affiliate that received a commission via this transaction. Can be available only for 'invoice_payment' and 'paid_media_payment' transactions.

annotations.name: invoice_payload
annotations.description: Optional. Bot-specified invoice payload. Can be available only for 'invoice_payment' transactions.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Bot-specified invoice payload. Can be available only for “invoice_payment” transactions.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Bot-specified invoice payload. Can be available only for 'invoice_payment' transactions.

annotations.name: subscription_period
annotations.description: Optional. The duration of the paid subscription. Can be available only for 'invoice_payment' transactions.
annotations.html_description: Optional. The duration of the paid subscription. Can be available only for “invoice_payment” transactions.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. The duration of the paid subscription. Can be available only for 'invoice_payment' transactions.

annotations.name: paid_media
annotations.description: Optional. Information about the paid media bought by the user; for 'paid_media_payment' transactions only
annotations.html_description: Optional. Information about the paid media bought by the user; for “paid_media_payment” transactions only
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Information about the paid media bought by the user; for 'paid_media_payment' transactions only

annotations.name: paid_media_payload
annotations.description: Optional. Bot-specified paid media payload. Can be available only for 'paid_media_payment' transactions.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Bot-specified paid media payload. Can be available only for “paid_media_payment” transactions.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Bot-specified paid media payload. Can be available only for 'paid_media_payment' transactions.

annotations.name: gift
annotations.description: Optional. The gift sent to the user by the bot; for 'gift_purchase' transactions only
annotations.html_description: Optional. The gift sent to the user by the bot; for “gift_purchase” transactions only
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. The gift sent to the user by the bot; for 'gift_purchase' transactions only

annotations.name: premium_subscription_duration
annotations.description: Optional. Number of months the gifted Telegram Premium subscription will be active for; for 'premium_purchase' transactions only
